verdict.rationale: Pomelo documents an external authorization flow ('Autorizar y ajustar transacciones') and a configured authorization endpoint, but nothing in the evidence describes the fields an authorization event carries. There is no mention of merchant name or MCC in the payload, enhanced merchant data, wallet or entry-mode details, or partial-approval and incremental-auth signals. Merchant/category blocking rules and wallet tokenization are adjacent features and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, every authorization event carries decision-grade context — merchant name and MCC, enhanced merchant data, wallet and entry-mode details, partial-approval and incremental-auth signals
